subject: Co-sell approval & evidence sprint: CloudBridge / Redwood bundle
messages:
From: Claire Benton <claire@cloudbridge.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing & co-sell — next steps and evidence ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — excited about the CloudBridge + Redwood bundle. The Marketplace team at AWS asked us to provide a consolidated evidence packet so they can fast-track the co-sell approval. Can you confirm what Redwood needs from our side (SLA language, architecture, SOC evidence, etc.), and whether Redwood can provide any marketplace-facing marketing collateral?

Attached is a high-level architecture diagram and our draft SOW for the pilot. We generally need co-sell enablement by end of December to meet our internal launch dates.

Quick asks: 
- Can Redwood provide an official partner one-pager and a joint solution description?
- Who on your side will own the technical evidence (e.g., SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagrams) for the AWS submission?
- Any blockers from Redwood for a private listing + co-sell?

Looping Sam on operational items. Happy to jump on a 30-min working session this week.

Best,
Claire Benton
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Solutions
claire@cloudbridge.io
Attachment: architecture_diagram.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
Attachment: sow_draft.docx (docx, 240KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benton <claire@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & co-sell — next steps and evidence ask

Claire — thanks for the materials and timeline. We’re aligned on the high-level ask and can move quickly. Below is our proposed split of responsibilities and an initial evidence checklist. I think a short working sprint next week (Mon/Tue) will get us into AWS review by mid-December.

Redwood deliverables (we will own):
- Redwood partner one-pager and joint solution blurb (marketing) — I’ll circulate drafts by EOD Thursday.
- Redacted SOC2 summary & compliance statement for Marketplace intake (security) — Ben will own.
- Marketplace listing operational metadata (billing SKU mapping, entitlements) — Aditya will prep the SKU map and metering notes.

CloudBridge deliverables:
- Final SOW and pilot acceptance criteria (you provided draft; please send final by Mon).
- Network/data flow diagram with external vendor endpoints and any customer-managed keys called out.

Initial evidence checklist (attached spreadsheet):
- Architecture diagram (received)
- SAML/OAuth integration doc
- Data retention & encryption summary
- SOC2 summary (redacted)
- Commercial terms / POC pricing
- Marketing one-pager for listing

Ben/Aditya — can you both confirm availability for a 30-min sync Monday 11/30 or Tuesday 12/1 to triage the security and SKU asks? Also flag any gaps in the attachments.

Claire — tagging AWS so they have visibility to our timeline. If the Marketplace team needs a CFN or listing stub, call it out and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0199
Attachment: marketplace_evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Claire Benton <claire@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & co-sell — evidence sprint (SOC & security)

Priya / Claire — I can take point on the SOC2 summary and the redacted controls mapping. A couple of notes after skimming the diagram:
- The diagram shows CloudBridge contacting an external analytics SaaS; we need a short third-party vendor list + data processing agreements to include in the Marketplace intake.
- For SAML/OAuth we prefer that CloudBridge provide an IdP flow doc (SAML metadata + example assertion) — that will speed the entitlements review.

I’ll prepare the redacted SOC summary and a controls mapping doc. ETA for a first pass: Tue 12/1 EOD. If Aditya can send the SKU map and metering notes today, I’ll fold commercial items into the doc.

Ben Carter
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (will attach redacted_soc_summary.pdf in next email)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Claire Benton <claire@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & co-sell — SKU map & metering notes

Quick update — I uploaded the initial SKU mapping and metering rationale to our internal drive and included the link below. Summary: we propose two SKUs for the launch (pilot and standard) with per-seat metering and optional usage-based add-on for GPU inference hours. Notes:
- Pilot SKU (flat monthly price for up to 5 seats) — useful for initial customers and co-sell pilots.
- Standard SKU (per-seat with optional inference-hours metering) — aligns with Redwood billing primitives.

Link: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/CB-2026-341/sku-map (internal)

Ben — I flagged the third-party vendor list in the sheet; Claire / Sam — can you add the vendor names and DPA status?

-Aditya
Senior Product Ops, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 08:17 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priya / Claire — I can take point on the SOC2 summary...

From: Claire Benton <claire@cloudbridge.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & co-sell — final items and DocuSign

Thanks everyone — this is looking good. Per internal, I attached an updated SOW with clearer acceptance criteria and added the third-party vendor list as requested.

Next steps I took:
- Final SOW uploaded and DocuSigned: https://app.docusign.com/CB-SOW-2026
- Added vendor list and DPA statuses in the Architecture doc (see attachment).
- I’ll add the SAML metadata file to the Drive by end of day Monday.

Priya — once Ben sends the redacted SOC and Aditya confirms SKU map is shared to our drive, we should be ready to submit to AWS Marketplace. Can Redwood also produce a short joint solution blurb (1-paragraph) we can include in the listing?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Claire
Attachment: sow_final_signed.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
